name: SplatFormer Training Objective & Refinement
definition: A feed-forward refinement module that corrects 3DGS bias towards input views by learning data-driven priors from diverse 3D objects and view configurations, enabling robust novel view synthesis under out-of-distribution (OOD) camera angles.
summary: SplatFormer is a feed-forward neural module that refines 3D Gaussian Splatting representations using a point transformer to predict attribute residuals, enabling robust novel view synthesis from out-of-distribution camera angles.
